text_en: Therefore, while the promise of entering his rest is still open, let us take care that none of you should seem to have failed to reach it.
text_cn: 所以，几时进入他安息的恩许仍然存在，我们就应存戒心，免得你们中有人得不到安息，

text_en: For indeed the good news came to us just as to them; but the message they heard did not benefit them, because they were not united by faith with those who listened.
text_cn: 因为我们也蒙受了喜讯，有如我们的祖先一样；可是他们所听到的话为他们毫无益处，因为他们听的时候没有怀着信德。

text_en: For we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, “As in my anger I swore, ‘They shall not enter my rest, ’” though his works were finished at the foundation of the world.
text_cn: 所以我们这些信了的人，必得进入安息，就如经上说的：“我在怒中起誓说：他们决不得进入我的安息。”其实天主的化工从创世时已经完成了，

text_en: For in one place it speaks about the seventh day as follows, “And God rested on the seventh day from all his works. ”
text_cn: 因为圣经某处论及第七日说：“天主在第七天停止了自己的一切工作，开始安息。”

text_en: And again in this place it says, “They shall not enter my rest. ”
text_cn: 但这里又说：“他们决不得进入我的安息。”

text_en: Since therefore it remains open for some to enter it, and those who formerly received the good news failed to enter because of disobedience,
text_cn: 那么，既然这安息还保留着要一些人进入，而那些先听到喜讯的人，因背信没有进入；

text_en: again he sets a certain day—“today”—saying through David much later, in the words already quoted, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts. ”
text_cn: 因此天主重新指定了一个日子，即一个“今天”，就是在很久以后藉达味所宣示的，如上边说过的：“今天你们如果听从他的声音，不要再心硬了。”

text_en: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not speak later about another day.
text_cn: 假使若苏厄实在使祖先安息了，此后天主便不会再论及别的一个日子。

text_en: So then, a sabbath rest still remains for the people of God;
text_cn: 由此看来，为天主的百姓，还保留了一个安息的时日。

text_en: for those who enter God’s rest also cease from their labors as God did from his.
text_cn: 的确，谁进入了天主的安息，他也就停止自己的工作而安息，正如天主停止自己的工作而安息一样。

text_en: Let us therefore make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one may fall through such disobedience as theirs.
text_cn: 所以我们要努力进入那安息，免得有人照样因背信而跌倒。

text_en: Indeed, the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing until it divides soul from spirit, joints from marrow; it is able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
text_cn: 天主的话确实是生活的，是有效力的，比各种双刃的剑还锐利，直穿入灵魂和神魂，关节与骨髓的分离点，且可辨别心中的感觉和思念。

text_en: And before him no creature is hidden, but all are naked and laid bare to the eyes of the one to whom we must render an account.
text_cn: 没有一个受造物，在天主面前不是明显的，万物在他眼前都是袒露敞开的，我们必须向他交账。

text_en: Since, then, we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold fast to our confession.
text_cn: 我们既然有一位伟大的，进入了诸天的司祭，天主子耶稣，我们就应坚持所信奉的真道，

text_en: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who in every respect has been tested as we are, yet without sin.
text_cn: 因为我们所有的，不是一位不能同情我们弱点的大司祭，而是一位在各方面与我们相似，受过试探的，只是没有罪过。

text_en: Let us therefore approach the throne of grace with boldness, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
text_cn: 所以我们要怀着依恃之心，走近恩宠的宝座，以获得仁慈，寻到恩宠，作及时的扶助。
